verdict.rationale: Clipboard sharing is a fair question for a remote-desktop product like Parsec, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions clipboard sync in either direction or a setting to disable it. Related features (privacy mode, keyboard/mouse support, host control over which apps guests can see) are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a power user, the clipboard moves both ways between host and viewer, and I can turn that off
